First-order autoregressive model

Source: R/AR1.R
AR1.Rd

This function is a wrapper around the forecast::Arima() function. It creates a first-order autoregressive model with a constant term. The Arima() function is itself a wrapper of the arima() function.

Usage

AR1(x)

Arguments

x

a vector, ideally a timeseries vector

Value

an Arima model

Examples

(m1 <- AR1(LakeHuron))
#> Series: x 
#> ARIMA(1,0,0) with non-zero mean 
#> 
#> Coefficients:
#>          ar1      mean
#>       0.8375  579.1153
#> s.e.  0.0538    0.4240
#> 
#> sigma^2 = 0.5199:  log likelihood = -106.6
#> AIC=219.2   AICc=219.45   BIC=226.95
AIC(m1)
#> [1] 219.1959
(m2 <- AR1(bacon$value))
#> Series: x 
#> ARIMA(1,0,0) with non-zero mean 
#> 
#> Coefficients:
#>          ar1    mean
#>       0.9720  6.1917
#> s.e.  0.0185  0.4317
#> 
#> sigma^2 = 0.02769:  log likelihood = 43.42
#> AIC=-80.83   AICc=-80.62   BIC=-72.49
